component.name: EITaaS Connect
component.summary: Prepare and launch smart-card remote desktop sessions

description.p: EITaaS Connect is a small desktop helper for Azure Virtual Desktop sessions that use a smart card (PIV). It checks that the bundled client, the desktop session, the smart-card stack, and the identity broker are ready before you connect.

Import an exported .rdpw profile and it is moved into a private, per-user store with restrictive permissions. Pressing Connect launches the bundled eitaas-remmina client for that profile. Sign-in and PIN prompts happen inside the client, never in this helper.
EITaaS Connect is independent community software. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Microsoft or the U.S. Government. It sends no telemetry.
Initial release: readiness checks, .rdpw profile import, and one-click launch of the bundled client.
